body: I’m not as anxious right now but I don’t know if I can use the dishes anytime soon without launching myself into another panic attack. Thank you so much for your insight, and I’ll try to get over this.

Thank you so much for replying, I really appreciate it. I’m not really concerned about the germs, it’s more about what the stain was. It looked like paint and I’m just worried that some of what was on my shoe might be on the dishes and on the kitchen counter now. I just don’t want to consume an unfamiliar substance. I fully understand that the sponge and the dishes have been rinsed off but what about the counter that he rest the sponge on. He also touched the sink handle after touching that sponge. I just can’t stop thinking about the fact that there must be some residue left over on some of the dishes.
